about.lead: LearnWithHistories is a free website for learning languages by reading short stories.
about.missionDesc: Make reading in another language feel light and possible from day one, with help at the right moment and no sign-up or payment barriers.
about.whyDesc: A story gives you a reason to keep reading. Characters, places and situations create context, and context helps you remember words and structures without memorized lists.
about.pillar1Desc: Every word appears in a meaningful sentence, inside a scene.
about.pillar2Desc: Stories bring the customs, places and expressions of the people who speak the language.
about.pillar3Desc: Short passages and on-demand translation let you move at your own pace.
about.feature1: Stories split into passages of 2–3 sentences
about.feature3: Portuguese, English, French and Spanish, in any combination
